contrasts.licensing_quote: It is worth stressing that despite the shared "HQ-9" family name, the Army and PAF systems appear to be genuinely separate procurement lines rather than a single system fielded twice — different missile rounds, reportedly different engagement radars, and, per at least one regional analyst briefing seen by this publication, possibly different fire-control architectures tailored to each service's requirements.
